text:
Ana: heads-up — merge-queue sweep at 18:00 PT today. Planning to sweep all open PRs and ship the minor bumps for api/runtime/console/sdk. If you need a hotfix pin or exception to the cutoff, reply here now.
Jamal: @Ana SDK PR needs a pin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512 — breaking header change. can we patch instead of minor? :thinking: 
Sophia: I can land runtime 0.14.2 today, changelog drafted in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345 — will run e2e after fixes. @Matt can you hold console bump until runtime is green?
Matt: prefer cutoff at 17:30 PT to avoid last-minute merges. if runtime is green by 17:00 I can flip console bump. cc @Evan
Evan: CI alert — runtime/main flaky e2e kv-cache timeout. digging. failing job: https://ci.internal/runs/9876 :mag: 
ci-bot: CI status: runtime/main — 1 failed job (kv-cache flake). rerun queued.
Sophia: reran tests, flaky test muted in PR, new run green locally. will push fix in 10m.
Jamal: for SDK PR, I can do patch bump and compatibility shim in api client. will open follow-up PR if needed. :thumbsup:
Ana: thanks. action items: 1) @Sophia push runtime fix by 17:10; 2) @Jamal switch SDK to patch and open follow-up; 3) @Matt hold console bump until 17:30 cutoff and confirm; 4) @Evan monitor CI and escalate if >2 reruns. If you need an exception, use /release-exception and tag me.
Matt: noted. will hold. if runtime stays green I'll merge console/publish at 17:35 and tag release manager bot.
release-manager-bot: Reminder: cutoff policy enforced. Exceptions require approval from release leads. Use /release-exception in this thread. :robot_face:
Ana: final check — anyone else with PRs needing a pin? otherwise we'll sweep at 18:00 PT and cut the version bumps. :eyes:
